title: LabelDefinition
description: Schema definition for a single ontology label — the fundamental unit of UPP's taxonomy. Labels categorize facts into structured categories within an ontology.

name.description: Machine-readable label key. MUST use the format {category}_{descriptor} (e.g., 'who_name', 'where_home'). Lowercase alphanumeric with underscores, starting with a letter.

description.description: Concise description of what this label captures.

category.description: Top-level grouping defined by the ontology (e.g., user/v1 uses WHO, WHAT, WHERE, etc.).

sensitivity.description: Privacy sensitivity tier. Higher tiers require stronger consent.

cardinality.description: Whether the label accepts one value (singular) or many (plural). Singular labels trigger supersession on new values.

durability.description: Expected lifespan of facts under this label: permanent, transient, or ephemeral.

examples.description: Example values to guide classification and extraction.

classification_guidance.description: Classification and disambiguation guidance for label extraction.

anti_examples.description: Counter-examples to clarify label boundaries and prevent misclassification.
